core_obligations: Form the spectral sequence R^p f_* H^q(E) => R^{p+q} f_* E.
The support of H^q(E) is proper over S, so each R^p f_* H^q(E) is coherent by the support-pushforward lemma.
Only finitely many terms contribute per total degree, hence R^{p+q} f_* E is coherent: Rf_*E in D_Coh(O_S).
Boundedness below is trivial (E in D^b); boundedness above from the higher-direct-image quasi-coherence lemma.
proof_roadmap: Spectral sequence; coherence of entries; finite contribution; boundedness.
difficulty_reason: A spectral-sequence argument with a named coherence input and a bookkeeping finish.
